notes: Built from SBI's Platinum International Debit Card page (updated 1 Oct 2026) and SBI's debit card charges page. Network is Visa (cardholder). Not stated on the pages: the value of an SBI Reward Point, the meaning of 'cap of Rs. 1,000 per transaction', and the number of lounge visits or any spend condition for them.

items.label: Annual maintenance ₹325 + GST, charged from the second year
items.clause: Platinum Debit Card: Issuance ₹300/- plus GST; Annual maintenance ₹325/- plus GST, recovered at the beginning of the second year onwards

items.label: Card replacement ₹300 + GST
items.clause: Replacement — All other Debit Cards: Rs. 300/- + GST

items.label: International purchases (shop or online): 3% + GST
items.clause: International Transaction Charges — Point of Sale (PoS)/ eCommerce transactions: 3% of transaction amount plus GST

earnRules.label: 2 SBI Reward Points per ₹200 on shopping, dining, fuel, travel and more
earnRules.clause: Earn 2 Reward Points per Rs.200 spent ... Earn up to 10,000 SBI Reward Points every month with a cap of Rs. 1,000/- per transaction

earnRules.label: 2x points on international spends (4 per ₹200)
earnRules.clause: Earn 2x Reward Points on international spending, online or in-store

exclusions.label: Wallet loads and prepaid top-ups (MCC 6540) don't count toward the ₹1 lakh monthly bonus

milestones.label: Spend ₹1 lakh in a month (shop + online) for 1,000 bonus points
milestones.clause: Earn 1,000 Bonus Reward Points on PoS and E-comm spends of ₹1 lakh or more in a month

otherBenefits.label: Complimentary domestic airport lounge access
otherBenefits.detail: SBI says Platinum cards include domestic lounge access 'subject to Terms & Conditions' but doesn't give the number of visits or any spend condition. Check with SBI before relying on it.
otherBenefits.clause: SBI Platinum Cards are one of the select variants of the Cards having complimentary domestic airport lounge access subject to Terms & Conditions applies

otherBenefits.label: 2x points in your birthday month
otherBenefits.detail: Double reward points on debit card spends during your birthday month.
otherBenefits.clause: Earn 2x Reward Points on spends made with your Debit Card during your birthday month

otherBenefits.label: Up to 300 bonus points for the first three payments
otherBenefits.detail: Within two months of issue, payments of ₹2,000 or more: 50 points for the 1st, 100 for the 2nd, 150 for the 3rd.
otherBenefits.clause: Up to 300 bonus points for three payments within two months of issuance, minimum transaction Rs. 2,000

otherBenefits.label: 'Cap of ₹1,000 per transaction' on points
otherBenefits.detail: The page doesn't say whether this limits points per payment or only the first ₹1,000 of each payment earning points. Not used in recommendations until confirmed.
otherBenefits.clause: with a cap of Rs. 1,000/- per transaction

otherBenefits.label: Daily limits: ATM ₹1,00,000; shop + online ₹2,00,000 (domestic)
otherBenefits.detail: International online: ₹50,000 per transaction and per month, at select sites only.
otherBenefits.clause: Daily ATM cash maximum Rs. 1,00,000; Daily PoS/online maximum Rs. 2,00,000; Online (international) Rs. 50,000 per transaction and per month

otherBenefits.label: Redeem points on rewardz.sbi, SBI Rewardz app, YONO or net banking
otherBenefits.detail: Bill payments and FASTag, BookMyShow tickets, merchandise, vouchers and travel bookings.
otherBenefits.clause: Redeem on rewardz.sbi, SBI REWARDZ App, Yono App and RINB
